name: expense-api
description: Owns expense claims and receipts: claim CRUD, employee submission, manager approval/rejection, receipt photo storage in its own database (upload and retrieval — no external object storage), the team's weekly spending limit (read and set), and the fixed daily Meals policy check (5,000 LKR/day, cumulative) computed and flagged with a plain-language reason at submission time. Does not extract receipt data itself (the receipt-agent does), does not parse natural language into a limit itself (the limit-agent does), does not enforce the weekly limit or the Meals policy against a submission (both are flagged, never blocking), and does not process reimbursement payment.
